_source: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia. 'Grade 10-12 Geography Syllabus' (2013, published by CDC), Section C (Elements of Human Geography) — all of Grade 11. Outcome text and order manually traced against each sub-topic heading rather than trusted from printed codes alone. Rebuilt 2026-08-31 to add real term/week/reference data and substantial real content from a second real source, 'MINISTRY OF GENERAL EDUCATION SOCIAL SCIENCES PROVINCIAL SCHEMES OF WORK — SOUTHERN PROVINCE, GEOGRAPHY' — a province-level document (no individual teacher/school named, nothing to sanitize), covering all 3 grades × all 3 terms. Topics renumbered 11.1-11.5 to match this source's real teaching order (confirmed against its own clean end-of-document 'GEOGRAPHY TOPICS' Grade 11 summary list: Population → Settlement → Fuel/Energy/Power → Agriculture → Field Project), which differs from this file's earlier arbitrary ordering. Two topics are genuinely new, not fabricated — 'Settlement Studies in Zambia' and 'Geography Field Project' — the earlier version of this file simply never had a source covering them. The old 'World Population' topic (11.3.1/11.3.2) is folded into the new, richer 11.1 (real Zambia-specific population content the old sub-topics didn't have); old 'Farming' (11.1) and 'Fuel and Energy' (11.2) content is preserved and enriched under their new real numbers/positions (11.4, 11.3) with real week/reference data added. Each sub-topic's week_number is the real week it was first introduced (not every week it was reviewed).
